name: Blavor Solar Power Bank
description: Keep your essential devices charged off the grid with this rugged, waterproof solar power bank. It harnesses the sun's energy to provide reliable backup power wherever your adventures take you. Features a built-in compass and dual flashlights for ultimate outdoor utility.

name: LuminAID PackLite Max 2-in-1
description: Illuminate your campsite and charge your phone with this brilliant inflatable solar lantern. It collapses flat for easy packing and inflates into a lightweight, shatterproof beacon of light. Perfect for emergency kits, camping trips, and sustainable outdoor living.

name: Logitech K750 Wireless Solar Keyboard
description: Experience effortless typing with a sleek keyboard that powers itself through ambient light, eliminating the need for battery replacements. Its ultra-thin design and comfortable key layout make it a stylish addition to any eco-conscious workspace. Enjoy reliable wireless connectivity and continuous performance, even in low-light environments.

name: ABFOCE Solar Bluetooth Speaker
description: Bring your favorite tunes into the wild with this rugged solar-powered Bluetooth speaker. It absorbs sunlight to continuously charge its battery, delivering crisp audio and deep bass for hours on end. Water-resistant and highly durable, it is the perfect companion for beach days and hiking trips.

name: ECEEN Solar Powered Backpack
description: Carry your gear and generate sustainable energy on the move with this innovative solar backpack. Integrated high-efficiency solar panels effortlessly charge your smartphones and tablets as you walk. Crafted from durable, weather-resistant materials to keep your belongings safe and secure.

name: MPOWERD Luci Outdoor 2.0
description: Brighten the darkest nights with this incredibly lightweight and durable solar lantern. It features adjustable brightness settings and a fully waterproof design that floats on water. Harnessing clean solar energy, it provides a safe and eco-friendly alternative to traditional gas lanterns.
